title: deck.item_put
description: Adds an item to a user deck or moves it. Whole-row last-writer-wins on hlc together with deck.item_removed. OPS.md#deckitem_put

deck_id.description: Deck; must exist and be of type user.

item_key.description: What is (or was) in the deck. entity_id = '<deck_id>|<item_key>'. For 'n:' keys the note must exist.

position.description: Ascending new-card order within the deck; sparse (clients space by 1024).
